title: Kiss our halldoor
html_source: This comes from the Jewish tradition of touching or kissing the mezuzah, a piece of scripture contained in a decorative case and affixed to doorways and thresholds in fulfillment of a biblical commandment (Deuteronomy 6:9, “write the words of God on the gates and doorposts of your house”). In some communities it is traditional to touch it when passing through; in others, kissing it (or the hand that touched it) is more common.
